brief:
Israeli intelligence has identified Iranian efforts to develop chemical and biological weapons, according to Al-Monitor. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is pressing for swift military action against Tehran, though sources indicate his campaign is shaped by his own political calendar rather than purely by security assessments.

The push comes as the Trump administration weighs how to respond to Iranian nuclear developments and regional threats. Netanyahu's timeline for action appears disconnected from the technical urgency of the weapons threat, sources familiar with Israeli strategy said.
dek: Israeli intelligence points to Iranian efforts to develop chemical and biological weapons, but sources say Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s push for a strike against the Tehran regime is driven by his own political timetable.
title: Israel pushes Trump toward rapid Iran air strikes
